contract: POST /api/cache/purge (admin and up) answers 200 and deletes the whole metadata/cache directory, then recreates the empty cache, covers, images and items directories. Cache files are disposable: item metadata and library rows stay untouched, and a purge still works when the cache directory is missing.

invariants.contract: A successful purge removes every file below metadata/cache (including the directory itself) and recreates the empty cache, covers, images and items directories; it also succeeds and recreates them when metadata/cache is missing. Files below metadata/items and libraryItems rows are unchanged, and a later purge removes cover and image entries an items-only purge kept.

invariants.contract: A repeated purge operates on the cache as it is at that moment: entries written between two calls are removed and no stale or duplicate cache state remains; the result is the same empty covers, images and items directories.
